title: Emergency alerts
tldr: Check an official alert for your exact location, hazard, timing and required action. Enable emergency alerts on your phone and add local emergency management notifications. Keep a battery radio as backup rather than relying on one app.
steps: Review emergency notification settings and keep the phone charged.
Sign up with your county or city emergency management office and utility.
For weather hazards, use NOAA Weather Radio or your local official warning service.
Distinguish preparation notices from instructions to shelter or evacuate.
next: Write down local frequencies and contact information. Test devices and accessibility features with your household.
watch: Alerts can be delayed or missed. Act on obvious immediate danger and natural warning signs.
review_status: source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
